page.overview:
Who is Cia Ferisc?

Cia Ferisc was a Silinese warrior who, when she was between the ages of fifteen and twenty-five, participated in that year's Crowning Convocation. During the survival level of the competition, Ferisc snuck up on Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar, a fellow participant. Fandar was distracted while planning a way to get fruit from a uavin tree without being able to use the Force.

Posing as a potential ally, the Silinese tricked Fandar into letting his guard down under the false pretense of helping one another get fruit. She then stole his makeshift staff and fled. As Fandar pursued her through the forest, he was soon joined by his friend Sitia Arthyst. The latter eventually caught Ferisc, tackling her. Ferisc lost the resulting fight, effectively ending her prospects in the competition. Her supplies were subsequently looted by Fandar and Arthyst. This upset Ferisc, and she threw scathing words at Arthyst, though her insults had minimal effect on the other Silinese.
